messages.content: 什麼樣的肥料最適合種植番茄？

function.name: soil_analysis_analyze_soil_type
function.description: Analyze a type of soil and provides characteristics about it. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

soil_type.description: The type of the soil. For example, loam, sandy, etc.

parameters_needed.description: Optional specific characteristics of the soil to analyze.

message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "什麼樣的肥料最適合種植番茄？" They want advice on what kind of fertilizer is best for growing tomatoes. We can provide general guidance: balanced NPK fertilizers, organic compost, use of slow-release granules, etc. We can also mention specific ratios like 10-10-10 or 5-10-5, but also mention that tomatoes need more phosphorus and potassium than nitrogen. Also mention micronutrients like magnesium, calcium, iron. Also mention that using too much nitrogen can lead to lush foliage but poor fruit set. Also mention that using compost tea, fish emulsion, worm castings, bone meal, blood meal, etc. Also mention that using a balanced fertilizer at planting time, then switching to higher P and K later. Also mention that using a slow-release fertilizer can reduce over-fertilization. Also mention that using a pH-balanced fertilizer is important because tomatoes prefer slightly acidic soil (pH 6.0-6.8). Also mention that using a fertilizer with micronutrients like zinc, manganese, copper, boron can help. Also mention that using a fertilizer with a high potassium content can improve fruit quality. Also mention that using a fertilizer with a low nitrogen content can reduce leaf growth and increase fruit yield.
